author_or_review_requirements: Every guide is reviewed against current official UI/video or explicitly marks unresolved steps.

disclosure_requirements: Official links clearly distinguished from internal guide links.
update_policy_requirements: Song catalog rechecked during the 15-day launch campaign.
Platform, region, requirements and troubleshooting facts are dated.
Corrections recorded on the Updates page and Editorial Policy.

excluded_or_deferred.reason: No map intent, real map asset or reliable coordinates.
Uniform deep gameplay fields are unavailable; would create thin repetitive pages.
A complete catalog matches intent and avoids thin copyright-sensitive pages.
No authoritative complete public card/skill dataset.
Launch meta is unverified and unstable.
Process and value claims require live verification.
No confirmed conventional code system at Flow 02.
Help and page-level FAQs better match tasks.
No strong commercial decision intent in project scope.

risks: Framework is unknown and blocks Flow 05.
The song count and launch campaign change daily.
Holomem and song image coverage is large and requires a complete project-local asset/source ledger.
Card, quest, facility and troubleshooting fields may remain incomplete without live-game validation.
Production domain, email and brand are unspecified.
